objective:
Add the services that apply the USER's decisions on the tag pipeline, in core-domain services/ -- the tag twins of v3's ReviewResolutionService and CorrectionService (read both, services/ReviewResolutionService.kt and services/CorrectionService.kt, and ServiceRefusal.kt; mirror their structure, KDoc style, 'now read once', checks-before-writes, and do NOT modify them). Three services, all pure orchestration over repository calls that already exist (plus one small read, below). No UI, no app wiring.

BACKGROUND (built and tested, read the KDoc): LedgerRepository = ActivityRepository + TagRepository (repository/TagRepository.kt): loadTagCatalog(), acceptTagged(TaggedAcceptRequest(captureId, interpretation: InterpretationRecord, subject: TagTarget, action: TagTarget, occurredAt, timePrecision, activityState, durationSeconds, learnSubjectAlias, learnActionAlias)), correctTags(TagCorrectionRequest(occurrenceId, subject?, action?, duration: DurationChange?, learnSubjectAlias, learnActionAlias, source, reason, now)) -> CorrectionOutcome, renameTag(kind, tagId, newName) -> RenameOutcome(Renamed|NothingChanged|ConflictsWith(tagId)), mergeTags(kind, from, into) -> MergeOutcome(movedOccurrences, mergedPairs). TagTarget = Existing(tagId) | New(displayName) (repository vocabulary). tagging/CorrectionAliases.aliasesToLearn(extractedSubject, extractedAction, previousSubjectId, previousActionId, newSubject: TagChoice, newAction: TagChoice, catalog) -> LearnedAliases(subjectAlias, actionAlias) decides WHICH words are safe to learn (ADR-041) and TagChoice = Existing(tagId) | New(name) is its vocabulary. NewActivityNameCheck (naming/) validates new names. TaggedProposal / TaggedCaptureOrchestrator (services/, TG3.1, ADR-043) produce the words a screen shows; note TaggedProcessingOutcome.NeedsReview has both `reasons` (tag decision) and `problems` (ValidationReason).

ONE SMALL ADDITIVE READ (the only change outside services/): the correction path needs the words the model extracted for an occurrence, and the History resolution path needs them for a capture still waiting, and no repository read exposes them today (interpretations.extracted_subject / extracted_action / duration_expression are stored by TG3.1/acceptTagged). Add to TagRepository, implemented in RoomActivityRepository over an existing InterpretationDao with a plain read @Query (no write surface change): `data class ExtractedWords(val subject: String?, val action: String?, val durationExpression: String?)`; `suspend fun loadExtractedWordsForCapture(captureId: String): ExtractedWords?` -- the words of the capture's most recently created interpretation that has any extracted_* column non-null, else null; `suspend fun loadExtractedWordsForOccurrence(occurrenceId: String): ExtractedWords?` -- the words of the occurrence's EFFECTIVE interpretation, null if none/unknown. Both return null for unknown ids, never throw for them. KDoc the contract; extend the core-data tests (Robolectric, existing helpers) for both reads. Update every other implementer of TagRepository/LedgerRepository that exists in the code base so everything compiles (search main and test sources; if a fake outside your write_paths must change, report scope_change_requested instead of editing it).

SERVICE 1 -- `TaggedResolutionService(repository: LedgerRepository, clock: Clock)`: the user answers a confirm card or reviews a waiting capture.
`suspend fun resolve(captureId: String, subject: TagChoice, action: TagChoice, time: OccurrenceTime? = null, durationSeconds: Long? = null, activityState: ActivityState = ActivityState.COMPLETED, words: ExtractedWords? = null): TaggedResolutionResult` with `sealed interface TaggedResolutionResult { data class Resolved(val occurrenceId: String); data class Refused(val refusal: TagRefusal) }`.
Steps: now = clock.instant() once; capture missing -> Refused(CaptureNotFound); capture.hasOccurrence -> Refused(CaptureAlreadyHasOccurrence); chosen time defaults to OccurrenceTime(capture.capturedAt, INFERRED_NOW); after now -> Refused(OccurredAfterNow); negative duration -> Refused(InvalidDuration); catalog = loadTagCatalog(): an Existing choice not in the ACTIVE catalog -> Refused(TagNotFound) (unknown or merged: say which only if the repository lets you tell cheaply, else one code); a New name failing NewActivityNameCheck -> Refused(InvalidName(reason)) (a New name whose key equals an existing ACTIVE tag is NOT refused: the repository converges it, as acceptTagged documents). words default = repository.loadExtractedWordsForCapture(captureId). aliases = CorrectionAliases.aliasesToLearn(words.subject, words.action, previousSubjectId = null, previousActionId = null, subject, action, catalog). Store a fresh VALID user-resolution InterpretationRecord (use the USER_RESOLUTION_* constants from ReviewResolutionService; operation LOG_ACTIVITY; activityResolution UNRESOLVED; the extracted words and duration expression copied from `words`; resolvedDurationSeconds = durationSeconds; modelConfidenceBand null) and call acceptTagged with TagTarget mapped from the choices (trim New names) and learnSubjectAlias/learnActionAlias from the aliases. Earlier interpretations are never modified. IllegalArgumentException from the repository for a race (tag merged meanwhile) -> map to Refused(TagNotFound) only where the repository error can be told apart; otherwise let it propagate as v3 does.

SERVICE 2 -- same class or a sibling (your call): `suspend fun correct(occurrenceId: String, subject: TagChoice? = null, action: TagChoice? = null, duration: DurationChange? = null, reason: String? = null): TaggedCorrectionResult` with Applied(correctionId) | NothingChanged | Refused(TagRefusal). now read once; occurrence missing -> Refused(OccurrenceNotFound); HIDDEN -> Refused(OccurrenceHidden); the same tag/name/duration checks as resolve; an untagged (v3) occurrence needs BOTH subject and action (else Refused(BothTagsNeeded) -- check ActivityView.subjectId/actionId through repository.getActivity); words = loadExtractedWordsForOccurrence; previous ids = the occurrence's current pair (repository.getActivity(occurrence.canonicalActivityId)); aliases = CorrectionAliases.aliasesToLearn(words..., previous ids, newSubject = the given choice or Existing(previous subject id) when null, same for action, catalog) -- so an unchanged side never learns; call correctTags(source USER) and map CorrectionOutcome. Raw captures never change.

SERVICE 3 -- `TagManagementService(repository: LedgerRepository)`: `rename(kind: TagKind, tagId: String, newName: String): TagRenameResult` = Renamed | NothingChanged | NameInUse(otherTagId) (from RenameOutcome.ConflictsWith, so the screen can offer a merge) | Refused(TagRefusal); trims the name, rejects with InvalidName when NewActivityNameCheck fails, TagNotFound for unknown/merged/wrong-kind (IllegalArgumentException from the repository mapped, ids only). `merge(kind, fromTagId, intoTagId): TagMergeResult` = Merged(movedOccurrences, mergedPairs) | Refused(TagRefusal) with SameTag, TagNotFound. `suspend fun listTags(kind): List<ManagedTag>` where `ManagedTag(id, name, aliases: List<String>, pairCount: Int)` built from loadTagCatalog() (pairCount = number of catalog pairs using the tag), name-ordered as the catalog is.

`sealed interface TagRefusal` (new file, services/): CaptureNotFound, CaptureAlreadyHasOccurrence, OccurrenceNotFound, OccurrenceHidden, OccurredAfterNow, InvalidDuration, TagNotFound, InvalidName(reason: NewActivityNameCheck.Reason), BothTagsNeeded, SameTag. Do NOT add cases to the existing ServiceRefusal (the phone's exhaustive `when` over it must keep compiling).

TESTS: core-domain unit tests with a small fake LedgerRepository (reuse the pattern from TaggedCaptureOrchestratorTest's private fake; copy rather than share if it is private) for every refusal path and for the exact calls made (aliases passed, targets mapped, time default INFERRED_NOW, duration passed, nothing written on refusal); core-data Robolectric tests against the REAL ledger with the existing test database helpers, covering: resolve a waiting capture with an Existing pair and with New tags (occurrence saved, tags/pair created, alias learned only when safe -- e.g. user answers 'hot tub' for words 'furnace' -> no, rule cases from ADR-041: pick one that learns and one that must not), resolve twice -> second Refused(CaptureAlreadyHasOccurrence) with no extra rows; correct subject only (previous action kept, correction row once, alias learned for the changed side only); correct to a New name that converges on the current tag -> NothingChanged; correct hidden -> refused; correct an untagged v3 occurrence with one tag -> BothTagsNeeded and with both -> Applied; correct duration only; rename happy path / NameInUse(other id) / NothingChanged / blank-or-invalid name; merge happy path with pairs moved / SameTag / merged-away tag as target -> TagNotFound; listTags counts. No logging; refusal and exception messages carry no user words.

DOCS: ADR-044 in docs/DECISIONS.md ('Tag resolution, correction and management services', Accepted, developer decision 2026-10-04, TG3.2): refusals as a separate TagRefusal (why not ServiceRefusal), aliases are learned on resolve and correct only through CorrectionAliases, the extracted-words reads and why, unchanged side never learns, rename conflict is a result not an exception. docs/DATA_MODEL.md: add the two reads where the interpretation tag columns are described. No other doc changes.

RULES: v3 services, tagging/, extraction/, TaggedCaptureOrchestrator and the schema/entities/migrations are untouched; no @Update/@Upsert/@Delete or write @Query added anywhere; no logging; exception/refusal values never carry user words.
non_goals: No UI, no app-phone or app-wear change, no wiring (TG3.3-TG3.6).
No change to the tag decision policy, resolver, grounding, orchestrator or any write path of the repositories.
No schema change; if one is needed report scope_change_requested.
acceptance_criteria: TaggedResolutionService.resolve saves a waiting capture through acceptTagged with a fresh VALID user-resolution interpretation, default time INFERRED_NOW, duration passed through, and aliases decided only by CorrectionAliases; every refusal (capture missing / already has occurrence / future time / bad duration / unknown or merged tag / invalid new name) returns a TagRefusal and writes nothing; resolving twice never creates a second occurrence.

The correct operation changes subject and/or action and/or duration through correctTags with source USER, learns aliases only for a side that changed and only when CorrectionAliases allows it, returns NothingChanged without writes when nothing differs, refuses hidden/missing occurrences, and requires both tags for an untagged v3 occurrence.

TagManagementService rename/merge/listTags work as specified: rename conflict is the NameInUse result carrying the other tag id, invalid or blank names and unknown/merged/same tags are refused with TagRefusal, listTags returns names, aliases and pair counts.

The two extracted-words reads exist on TagRepository with KDoc, are implemented with plain read queries, return null for unknown ids, and are covered by tests; no write surface was added and every other TagRepository implementer still compiles.
TagRefusal is a new type; the existing ServiceRefusal and v3 services, orchestrator, tagging/extraction packages, schema, entities and migrations are unchanged.

The listed fake-repository and real-ledger tests pass; ADR-044 and the DATA_MODEL note are written; no logging; no user words in refusals or exception messages; all core-domain, core-data, core-testing and app-phone tests pass; no forbidden path changed.
